name: Sreenath Mohan
summary: A passionate and adaptable technology professional with a background in Electronics and a Master's degree in Computer Science. Skilled in both hardware and software domains, with hands-on experience in embedded systems, full-stack web development, and AI/ML integration. Proficient in tools and frameworks including Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Django, and various sensor technologies. Known for strong problem-solving skills, effective teamwork, and a genuine willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies. Demonstrated ability to build innovative, scalable solutions across academic, research, and real-world settings. Open to diverse roles in development, automation, AI, IoT, and systems engineering.

work_experience.title: Software Faculty / Developer
bullets: Instruct students on core programming languages, Data Science methodologies, and Power BI visualization workflows.
Deliver training modules and guide hands-on projects in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Electronics engineering concepts.
Mentor students in designing and deploying full-stack web applications and hardware-software integrations.
Develop internal software tools, automation scripts, and maintain up-to-date technology training curriculum standards.

work_experience.title: Data Science Intern
bullets: Built machine learning models using scikit-learn for predictive analytics.
Worked with data manipulation and analysis libraries including Pandas and NumPy to preprocess and clean structured datasets.
Participated in regression and classification tasks to uncover data-driven insights.

work_experience.title: Web Development Intern
bullets: Contributed to full-stack tasks in real-time college administration and information projects.
Gained hands-on experience in responsive UI development, API integration, debugging, and agile workflow.

project_experience.title: AI & Software Developer (Academic Project)
bullets: Developed an AI-powered chatbot providing conversational, semantic responses to queries related to IHRD colleges across Kerala.
Embedded structured institutional CSV datasets using Sentence Transformers and indexed with FAISS for fast semantic search.
Employed dual Google Gemini models—one for natural language conversational answering and another for automated field identification.
Designed and implemented an interactive, mobile-friendly chatbot UI using Streamlit featuring live chat history, exports, and resets.
Recognized with First Prize among Higher Education Department stalls in a state government exhibition.

project_experience.title: Full-Stack Developer (Academic Project)
bullets: Engineered a comprehensive diet and health platform spanning web and desktop applications.
Built pythonic Django backend integrated with scikit-learn models (K-Means, Random Forest) for recommendation engines.
Integrated Google Gemini API for an AI-powered dietician chatbot and Edamam API for generating 30-day meal plans.
Implemented secure user role-based access (user, admin, dietician), BMR calculations, and exercise tracking.
Designed responsive user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and jQuery, alongside a standalone Tkinter GUI desktop client.

project_experience.title: Full-Stack Developer (Project)
bullets: Developing a comprehensive e-commerce platform for agricultural products featuring secure authentication via Firebase and Google OAuth.
Engineered the backend with Node.js/Express.js, pg (PostgreSQL driver), Multer for image uploads, and SMTP for email confirmations.
Built the frontend with React.js using Context API for global state management and Jest for component testing.

project_experience.title: Frontend & React Developer (Project)
bullets: Engineered a scheduling web application using React.js to streamline medical clinic appointment bookings.
Implemented conflict detection, past date validations, custom appointment durations, and persistent storage via browser localStorage.
Conducted automated unit testing with Jest and React Testing Library to ensure high application stability and reliability.

project_experience.title: Embedded Systems Engineer (Project)
bullets: Designed and developed an autonomous robotic dog for real-time security and surveillance applications.
Programmed a PIC16F877A microcontroller in Embedded C using MPLAB IDE and XC8 compiler.
Integrated multi-sensor arrays (Ultrasonic, IR, PIR, Compass) to handle obstacle avoidance and autonomous pathfinding.
Built sound alert systems using Barking ICs and amplifiers, simulating security dog behaviors.
